I’m not able to place the booking directly right now due to a technical issue with the provider system, so I can’t dispatch someone from here. I’ll walk you through the fastest way to get an emergency plumber out and what to do right now to limit damage.

1) What to do immediately (if you can safely reach it)
- Look under the sink for two small shutoff valves (one for hot, one for cold) and turn both clockwise until they stop. That should cut water to the faucet and slow/stop the leak.
- If you can’t find those or they don’t fully stop the water, go to your main house shutoff:
  - Often in Fort Worth homes it’s in the front yard by the street in a ground box, or in the garage/exterior wall. Turn the valve clockwise to shut off the house water.
- Put towels, buckets, or pans under the cabinet and at the floor edge to keep water from spreading and seeping into more flooring.

2) How to get an emergency plumber ASAP near you
Since I can’t call on your behalf, do this on your phone right now:
- Open Google/Apple Maps and search: “emergency plumber near me” or “24 hour plumber 76102”.
- Focus on:
  - Rating: at least 4.0 stars
  - Response in reviews mentioning “same-day”, “after hours”, “emergency”
  - “Open now” and a local phone number (area codes like 817/682 etc.)

Call the top 2–3 that:
- Are open now
- Mention “24/7” or “emergency service”

3) What to say when you call (you can read this)
“Hi, my name is Vanessa Martinez. I’m at 1234 Main Street, Fort Worth, 76102. I have an active leak under my kitchen sink—there’s water under the cabinet and on the floor. Someone is home and can let the tech in anytime. Do you have an emergency plumber who can come out as soon as possible today? What’s your emergency service fee and approximate arrival time?”

Have ready:
- Your address: 1234 Main Street, Fort Worth, TX 76102
- Your phone: 916-555-7142
- Any photos of the leak (if they can text you a number to send them to)

4) While you’re waiting for the plumber
- Keep the water shut off if possible.
- Move anything that can be damaged (cleaning supplies, boxes, etc.) out of the cabinet.
- Keep drying the floor with towels so water doesn’t sit and warp the flooring; if you have a fan, point it at the wet area.

If you’d like, tell me what you find when you search (names or options), and I can help you pick the best one and refine what to ask them about price and timing.</action>
